rows.label: Harvard University
rows.description: private university in Cambridge, Massachusetts
rows.hook: is the oldest school of higher learning in the United States and the top of the Ivy League

rows.label: Yale University
rows.description: private university in New Haven, Connecticut
rows.hook: is an Ivy League school with secret societies like Skull and Bones and a bulldog mascot named Handsome Dan

rows.label: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
rows.description: private university in Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA, founded 1861
rows.hook: is a famous engineering school known for elaborate campus pranks called hacks

rows.label: University of Pennsylvania
rows.description: private research university in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States
rows.hook: is an Ivy League school founded by Benjamin Franklin and home to a famous business school

rows.label: Texas A&M University
rows.description: public research university in College Station, Texas, United States
rows.hook: is a school known for its Aggie traditions, a Corps of Cadets and the 12th Man

rows.label: Northwestern University
rows.description: private university in Evanston, Illinois, U.S.
rows.hook: is a Big Ten school on the shore of Lake Michigan, famous for its journalism program and Wildcats teams

rows.label: Brown University
rows.description: private university in Providence, Rhode Island, United States
rows.hook: is the Ivy League school with an open curriculum and a bear as its mascot

rows.label: University of Southern California
rows.description: private university in Los Angeles, California, United States
rows.hook: is a school whose Trojans football team is a longtime crosstown rival of UCLA

rows.label: University of Michigan
rows.description: public research university in Ann Arbor, Michigan

rows.label: Rice University
rows.description: private university in Houston, Texas, USA

rows.label: Carnegie Mellon University
rows.description: private research university in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States

rows.label: Duke University
rows.description: private university in Durham, North Carolina, USA

rows.label: Howard University
rows.description: university in Washington D.C.

rows.label: Brigham Young University
rows.description: private research university in Provo, Utah, United States
rows.hook: is a school run by the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, known for its honor code and Cougars teams

rows.label: University of Florida
rows.description: public research university in Gainesville, Florida, United States
rows.hook: is a school whose Gators teams play in the Swamp and which gave the world a famous sports drink

rows.label: Vanderbilt University
rows.description: private university in Nashville, Tennessee, US

rows.label: Georgetown University
rows.description: private university in Washington, D.C., United States

rows.label: Johns Hopkins University
rows.description: private university in Baltimore, Maryland, USA

rows.label: Ohio State University

rows.label: Tsinghua University
rows.description: public university in Beijing, China

rows.label: Arizona State University
rows.description: public university in Tempe, Arizona, US

rows.label: McGill University

rows.label: University of Alabama

rows.label: Al-Azhar University

rows.label: University of Arizona

rows.label: University of British Columbia
